engine: Springs brand-tinted reveal — a full-bleed photo arrives under a brand-colour WASH that then tints to 0 ON the photo as the section scrolls into view, so every photo gets a brief 'brand-tint' beat before it resolves to full colour. Harvested from D_springs (Place->Jogging SEAM-07, f099->f106: heavy green tint -> lighter -> full colour).

measured_teardown.move: as the section enters the viewport, a brand-colour overlay over a full-bleed photo animates opacity wash%->0 on the same scrub. The photo is solid the whole time; only the wash tints down, so the image surfaces from under the brand colour. Scroll-scrubbed, reversible.
measured_teardown.cited: Springs SEAM-07 f099 (heavy green tint) -> f102 (lighter) -> f106 (full colour).

wash.what: starting wash opacity = the brand-tint strength. 1.0 = a full brand cover that tints down (zero see-through on any background); lower (e.g. 0.7) only on a brand-coloured backdrop.

fadeImage.what: false = the photo is solid under the wash (recommended; composite never thins, any background). true = also crossfade the image 0->1 under the wash — only safe on a backdrop of the brand colour.

pinFactor.what: reserved pin length (this brick scrubs on entry, start 'top bottom' end 'top 30%', no hard pin).

manageLenis.what: create+drive a Lenis (false if the page owns one).

entry: BrandOverlayCrossfade.init(target, opts) -> { trigger, lenis, render, refresh, destroy }. Markup: .boc-stage > .boc-img(img, z1) + .boc-wash(brand-colour layer, z2) + [.boc-content](z3). Wash colour set in CSS (var --boc-wash / background) = the brand/section colour.
law: Lenis 1.1.13 -> gsap.ticker -> ScrollTrigger.update; lagSmoothing(0); render(prog) PURE (wash opacity = wash*(1-prog)); scrub on entry (start 'top bottom', end 'top 30%'); opacity ONLY on wash (+ optional image); GPU layers; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop over the scrubbed surface; NO WebGL; reduced-motion/<=820px -> static (image full, wash 0). ONE scroll owner per page.
gate_mode: normal — with fadeImage:false the media is always a solid , only the brand wash tints down; no two-render overlap. blank/jank/fps standard.
proven: lab: OUR QUADRO terrace render arrives under a full green brand wash that tints 1.0->0 as the section scrolls in (boc-ready, NOT boc-static). Composite coverage (img+wash) stays opaque the whole transition = zero see-through on any background (probed). Gate PASS: blank 2%, seam 0%, coSolid 0, 59.9fps, jank 1/686.
